newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia offers training to Mindanao Moslems.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia offers training to Mindanao Moslems.

text.p: Malaysia will offer economic training to Moslems on the Philippines' Mindanao island after the signing of a peace pact between Moslem separatists and the government, Bernama news agency reported on Wednesday.
It quoted Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi, who said Malaysia would make the offer to Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) leader Nur Misuari.
"I hope we can inform them formally, to Nur Misuari himself, that Malaysia is willing to offer any form of training they required," he said when interviewed on television on Wednesday.
Abdullah said Malaysia's assistance could include receiving students from the southern Philippines to attend courses on development strategies and related fields.
The peace accord, which formally ended 24 years of war that left resource-rich Mindanao impoverished, was signed on Monday.
Abdullah said Malaysia would join efforts to develop Mindanao, especially in infrastructure and housing.

He said Malaysia hoped that Moro refugees in Sabah state would return to their homeland in view of the latest developments. Thousands of Filipino Moslems fled to the Borneo island state during the insurgency.
